info.name: Moderation Service
info.description: Team 16, Student ID, please. Runs the demo end to end against the mock upstreams: mint a Moderator token, point the mock session at each fixture applicant, submit decisions, read them back, search the ban list. Set base_url and service_token; DEV_ENDPOINTS=true is required on the service.
